Overview.Name: Gubbala Vara Prasad
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer cubes (100 g) + any 1 fruit (apple, banana, orange or papaya)
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (1 bowl ~150 g) + paneer cubes (60 g)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry + curd (small bowl)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry + curd (small bowl)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & vegetable curry & curd + sprouts (small bowl)
Evening_Snack: Option 3: Small bowl sprouts or fruit
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer cubes (80 g) & vegetable curry + any 1 fruit
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg omelette (2 eggs) + any 1 fruit
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & curd (200 g) & cucumber salad + any 1 fruit

Notes_and_Tips: Keep non-veg limited to 1 meal per day as per your preference.
Start meals with paneer, eggs or chicken before rice to control overeating.
For cravings, eat a full meal first and wait 10 minutes before taking extra food.
Avoid fried and packaged foods, especially during stress or late nights.
Improve sleep to support thyroid health and fat loss.
